info.title: Raidr API
info.description: Backend API for Raidr including user authentication and profile management.

agreedToTerms.description: User confirmation of age and terms agreement

UserDto.description: Full user profile row returned by GET /user/whoami (scalar fields only; relations not loaded). Secrets omitted: password, OTP, firebaseUid, isNewUser, avatarUpdatedAt.

xp_progress.description: XP bank toward the next level (after current level thresholds).

nextLevel.description: Target level after completing the current level bar (level + 1).

levelProgressPercent.description: Progress toward next level (0–100). Bind level bar directly to this value.

xpRequiredForNextLevel.description: Total XP required to complete the current level (formula: 100 × level²).

xpRemainingForNextLevel.description: XP still needed to reach nextLevel (xpRequiredForNextLevel − xp_progress).

agreedToSafetyWarning.description: Indicates whether the user has agreed to the safety warning for this trip

locked.description: True if the avatar is locked (user level too low)

requiredLevel.description: User level required to unlock this avatar

claimCode.description: Claim code issued to this user when they claimed the reward

totalParticipants.description: Total number of participants who joined this event

hasClaimed.description: True if the current user has already claimed the reward

isRedeemed.description: True if the merchant has confirmed and handed over the reward

claimId.description: Claim record ID if this user has a claim

agreedToSafetyWarning.description: Indicates whether the user has agreed to the safety warning for this event/coin rush

B2bHoldProgress.description: B2B reward hold timer. Use progressPercent (0–100) directly for list/detail progress bars and "NN%" labels.

holdDurationHours.description: Total hold required (hours), e.g. 72 for "… / 72h" labels.

holdElapsedHours.description: Elapsed hold time in hours for "Xd Yh / …" labels.

holdStartedAt.description: Set when the player captures a B2B zone.

progressPercent.description: Hold progress 0–100. Bind UI progress bar to this value (e.g. divide by 100 for 0.0–1.0 widgets). Do not recalculate from hours on the client unless this field is null.

holdRemainingSeconds.description: Countdown until hold completes; format on client for "Time remaining".

ActiveCaptureSession.description: Active snatch/capture attempt in Redis for the current user. Present on GET /single-player/zones/{id} when a session exists. Use sessionGuardsRemaining for AR guard UI (not guardCount on the zone).

sessionGuardsRemaining.description: Guards left to eliminate in this capture attempt only.

remainingSec.description: Seconds left until capture timer completes.

SinglePlayerB2bBlock.description: Present when zoneType is B2B. Progress bar: hold.progressPercent (integer 0–100).

dailyDropXpNormal.description: Campaign + lifetime XP awarded on normal daily drop collect.

dailyDropXpRare.description: Campaign + lifetime XP awarded on rare daily drop collect.

UserLifetimeXpProgressDto.description: Returned on daily drop collect after XP award.

BrandMonthClientStateDto.description: Player-facing Brand Month progression (dashboard, active, history).

inventoryTotal.description: FCFS grand-prize stock for this campaign.

quantity.description: Catalog pool size (rare drops / reference stock).
